title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1970-12-31

ai_review.summary: Recording suffers from mislabeled song titles, with no clear comments on audio or performance quality.
ai_review.review: The sole review notes that the track titles are inaccurate, which can be frustrating for listeners trying to follow the setlist. Beyond this metadata issue, the reviewer provides no insight into the soundboard quality, audience mix, or the musical performance itself, leaving the overall impression of the show ambiguous.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single, brief review offering a moderate 3‑star rating and pointing out a labeling problem; no substantive information on performance or recording quality to adjust the score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments about sound clarity, mix balance, or source type. The only issue mentioned is that song titles are off, indicating a metadata problem rather than an audio defect.
